title: $400 Small-Medium Business Power Outage Support Grant Far West Region Oct 2024 – Guidelines
summary: This page provides guidelines for the $400 Small-Medium Business Power Outage Support Grant for the Far West Region following the October 2024 storm.
who_can_apply: Must be an Eligible Applicant who meets the eligibility criteria outlined in clause 4.

more_info.text: Request an Internal Review of a grant decision

external_links.text: Far West Region Storm from 17 October 2024 (AGRN 1149)

internal_links.text: Request an Internal Review of a grant decision

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the Small-Medium Business Power Outage Support Grant?
faqs.a: The grant is for Eligible Applicants who meet the eligibility criteria outlined in clause 4.

faqs.q: What is the purpose of this grant?
faqs.a: The program is being funded by the NSW Government and Transgrid.
A one-off payment of $400 will be made to eligible applicants.
